_comment: Built by tools/build_geo.py. Do not hand-edit geometry; edit the seed in the tool and rebuild.

zrh-terminal.name: Zurich Airport, Arrivals
zrh-terminal.what: Land here Friday 20:30. Back Saturday 07:00 for the fifth traveller, Sunday for the van, and once more on the 13th.

kloten-allegra.name: Allegra Lodge, Kloten
kloten-allegra.what: All three airport nights: a two-bedroom suite for the 4th and 5th, a family room for the 12th. Self check-in, so a 20:30 landing needs nobody at a desk.

zrh-rental.name: Rental Centre, Airport Center Level 1
zrh-rental.what: Collect the 7-seat van here on Sunday morning, from 06:00. The first two days need no car at all.

weggis-village.name: Weggis
weggis-village.what: Base for the last two nights before the airport, on the north shore of Lake Lucerne.

weggis-pier.name: Weggis boat pier
weggis-pier.what: SGV paddle steamers into Lucerne. The lake is the nicest way in.

lucerne-pier.name: Lucerne, Bahnhofquai pier
lucerne-pier.what: Boat arrives beside the station. The old town starts at the bridge.

lucerne-kapellbrucke.name: Kapellbrücke, Lucerne
lucerne-kapellbrucke.what: The covered wooden bridge, 1365. Five minutes on foot from the pier.

weggis-cablecar.name: Weggis cable-car station
weggis-cablecar.what: Luftseilbahn Weggis-Rigi Kaltbad. First car up around 08:10, then every half hour - check the board, a weekday differs from a Sunday.

rigi-kaltbad.name: Rigi Kaltbad
rigi-kaltbad.what: Change from the cable car to the cogwheel. Kanzeli viewpoint is an hour from here, gentle.

rigi-kanzeli.name: Kanzeli viewpoint
rigi-kanzeli.what: The easy one for the parents. Paved, level, straight out over the lake.

rigi-kulm.name: Rigi Kulm
rigi-kulm.what: 1,798 m. Queen of the Mountains. Summit paths are paved with a marked easier route.

lungern-lakeside.name: Lungern, old Brünigstrasse
lungern-lakeside.what: Free, and the reason to leave the main road: the 2012 bypass tunnel hides the lake entirely.

meiringen.name: Meiringen
meiringen.what: Passed through on the way out, and the gorge stop on the way home.

grindelwald-village.name: Grindelwald
grindelwald-village.what: Base for nights 2 to 5. Still book it first, but these dates fall before the Jodelfest rather than inside it.

grindelwald-terminal.name: Grindelwald Terminal
grindelwald-terminal.what: Both gondolas leave from here. Bus 121 is free on the guest card.

mannlichen-top.name: Männlichen gondola station
mannlichen-top.what: Top of the 19-25 minute gondola. The Panoramaweg starts at the door.

mannlichen-summit.name: Männlichen summit
mannlichen-summit.what: 2,343 m. The Royal Walk up is 20 minutes on a made path, and optional.

kleine-scheidegg.name: Kleine Scheidegg
kleine-scheidegg.what: End of the Panoramaweg. Cog train down to Grindelwald Grund from here.

grindelwald-grund.name: Grindelwald Grund
grindelwald-grund.what: Where the cog train from Kleine Scheidegg puts you down, beside the Terminal.

eigergletscher.name: Eigergletscher
eigergletscher.what: Eiger Express drops you here in 15 minutes. Change to the cog railway into the mountain.

jungfraujoch.name: Jungfraujoch, Top of Europe
jungfraujoch.what: 3,454 m, the highest railway station in Europe. Altitude sickness is common here: go slow.

stechelberg-parking.name: Schilthornbahn car park, Stechelberg
stechelberg-parking.what: CHF 11 for the day, open-air, no height limit. 22 km and about 30 minutes from Grindelwald.

gimmelwald.name: Gimmelwald
gimmelwald.what: First change on the way up. The cable car stops here whether you want it to or not.

murren-schilthornbahn.name: Mürren, Schilthornbahn station
murren-schilthornbahn.what: Second change. Mürren is car-free, and worth the walk through it.

birg.name: Birg
birg.what: 2,677 m. Thrill Walk cliff gangway is included and takes 20 minutes.

schilthorn.name: Schilthorn, Piz Gloria
schilthorn.what: 2,970 m. The revolving restaurant: brunch is CHF 38 alone, reservation mandatory.

murren-blm.name: Mürren BLM station
murren-blm.what: The other end of the village. Little mountain railway along the cliff to Grütschalp.

grutschalp.name: Grütschalp
grutschalp.what: Change to the cable car down. This is why the ticket to ask for is tariff D, the Rundreise.

lauterbrunnen.name: Lauterbrunnen
lauterbrunnen.what: Bottom of the cable car. Bus 141 back down the valley to the van at Stechelberg.

aareschlucht-west.name: Aareschlucht West
aareschlucht-west.what: Enter here. Walkways bolted to the wall of a limestone slot, 1.4 km through.

aareschlucht-ost.name: Aareschlucht Ost
aareschlucht-ost.what: Come out here, or turn round. There is a train back one stop if legs have had enough.

zrh-parking3.name: Zurich Airport, Parking 3
zrh-parking3.what: Rental returns, accepted around the clock. Dropped Saturday on the way in, which keeps the hire to six days.

zurich-hb.name: Zürich Hauptbahnhof
zurich-hb.what: Thirteen minutes from the airport. Both Zurich days start here.

rheinfall.name: Rhine Falls, Schloss Laufen
rheinfall.what: Fifty minutes direct, hourly. Optional on the rest day: lifts and a walkway drop you to a platform in the spray.

zurich-altstadt.name: Zurich Old Town, Lindenhof
zurich-altstadt.what: Flat, paved and small. Lindenhof, the Fraumünster windows, then the lake promenade.

albisguetli.name: Albisgütli, the Knabenschiessen
albisguetli.what: Zurich's own festival, 12-14 September. Free to walk into, and it runs until 01:30.

fluelen.name: Flüelen
fluelen.what: Rigi in cloud: boat down the dramatic far end of the lake and back by train, about CHF 27.

grindelwald-first.name: Grindelwald First
grindelwald-first.what: Any washed-out day. Cliff Walk free with the gondola. Skip the Flyer, 2-3 hour queues.

blausee.name: Blausee
blausee.what: The real bad-weather day: 49 km and 50 minutes from Grindelwald, and better than First for the parents.
